messages:
anna: heads-up: I hit NaNs in a fused FlashAttention run on bf16 at seq_len=4096 during nightly perf sweep. quick log snippet below.

raj: can you paste the exact command + env? also is kv cache involved?

anna: repro command:```MODEL=redwood-v1 \nSEQ=4096 \nKERNS=fused_flashattn \nCUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 \npython bench/run_infer.py --model $MODEL --seq_len $SEQ --dtype bf16 --batch 1 --kernel $KERNS --use_kv_cache true```

anna: log tail:```... attention_forward: softmax overflow detected: exp overflow -> inf -> nan at layer 18\nEPOCH_WARN: layer 18 softmax produced nan\nstack: fused_flashattn_kernel +0x12f3\n```

leo: is this only with cached KV? or occurs on cold start too?

anna: only after warmup with kv cache. cold-start runs to 4096/1 in bf16 looked OK for a few tries. once kv_len accumulates (~4096) the fused path produces NaNs ~25% of runs.

maya: that smells like numeric range growth when concatenating prefix kvs. bf16 has smaller mantissa; fused kernels often skip intermediate fp32 accum. do we do any exp stabilization (log-sum-exp) inside fused kernel?

anna: fused kernel uses a fast softmax that assumes inputs are within safe dynamic range; our fallback (flashattn2 blocked kernel) uses LSE.

ci-bot: CI bench summary: fused_flashattn | dtype=bf16 | seq=4096 | batch=1 => latency=48ms (1.8x speedup vs blocked), failures=3/12 runs (NaN). fp16 runs: latency=45ms, failures=0/12. fp8 (E4M3 simulated): failures=9/12, huge instability.

olivia: interesting: fp16 stable, bf16 unstable — may be due to exponent/accum differences or a promotion bug in kernel. which GPU arch?

anna: A100 80GB & GH200 both repro. nvprof shows big per-layer max values on Q*K accum before softmax at layers 17-19: max ~ 1.2e4 in bf16 runs (when NaN later).

raj: action items: 1) add per-layer min/max and max_abs trackers in runtime for a repro sweep (anna) 2) add lse-stable softmax as a deterministic fallback in fused kernel when max_abs > threshold (leo) 3) kernel selection heuristic: avoid fused_flashattn for bf16 when seq_len >= 2048 or kv_cache_hits > 0 until fixed (maya) 4) rerun CI across fp16/bf16/fp8 sims and log failures (ci-bot).

maya: also check kv concatenation ordering and whether we are doing in-place concat that could reduce precision. try running fused kernel with intermediate accumulation in fp32 (if supported) as an experiment.

anna: quick patch I tried: forced fp32 accumulation in fused kernel -> no NaNs in 50 runs, but perf regressed ~1.4x.

leo: ok reasonable tradeoff: perf > correctness. let's implement detection + fallback path rather than always using fp32. If threshold triggers, use lse path or fp32-accum.

olivia: for model-onboarding note: update model profiles to include a "fused_safe" flag computed from a small stress run (seq=4096, kv_warmup) so Dedicated customers don't get silent NaNs.

raj: assign owners: anna -> add telemetry + repro; leo -> prototype lse fallback in kernel; maya -> update kernel selection heuristic & tests; olivia -> model profile + docs. target PRs by EOD Thursday.

anna: I'll upload flame graphs + nvprof traces to the thread shortly. thanks all :thumbsup:
